visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a vibrant teal button-up sweater and grey plaid shorts, leans casually against a white vertical utility pole in an outdoor grassy area next to a white industrial building. The camera captures her in a medium shot, slightly handheld, under bright natural daylight with no visible text overlays initially. (2) The scene transitions indoors to a room with warm lighting and light-colored curtains. A young man in a brown oversized hoodie and the young woman, now in a black sweatshirt, stand together smiling. The man holds a blue shopping bag and some clothing items, indicating preparation for a project. (3) Close-up shots show a professional makeup kit including a black roll filled with various makeup brushes and transparent acrylic drawers housing multiple colorful eyeshadow palettes. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setup. (4) The young man is seen meticulously applying eyeshadow and liner to the young woman's eyes while she sits patiently. A ring light and a yellow flower-shaped stool are visible in the background. (5) The woman looks into a hand mirror, admiring the bold, dark smokey eye makeup that has been completed. She adjusts her hair, which is styled straight with a purple flat iron. (6) A final high-speed montage shows professional-style photos of the woman posing in her final look, featuring heavy makeup and the teal sweater, in various locations including an indoor hallway and the outdoor building exterior.
